messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "trouble chewing"
set: ["trouble chewing", "trouble swallowing", "trouble speaking", "trouble walking", "trouble climbing", "trouble breathing", "trouble hearing", "trouble concentrating", "trouble sleeping", "trouble standing", "swallow right away without chewing", "swallow mixture right away without chewing", "trouble lifting arms", "severe trouble sleeping", "allow to dissolve in mouth without chewing", "trouble starting to urinate"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
